description: Takes your company, product, partner model, partner goal and deal size, and returns a partner program with tiers, example commission amounts and KPIs, with a different structure for resellers, referrals, integrations, agencies, affiliates and white label. Uses your stated goal, existing partners and deal size, and names the partner types that fit your sector's buying committee.

business_model.description: Optional: how you earn revenue, so the advice fits it (saas, services, connectivity, transactions, marketplace, hardware_software or investment). Leave it out and the tool reads it from your other inputs and says how it read it

existing_partners.description: Optional: Current partner types/count, one per line or separated by semicolons (listed in the plan)

industry.description: Optional: the sector you sell into, so the answer uses that sector's buyers, measures and objections. Leave it out and the tool reads the sector from your other inputs and names what it read

partner_goals.description: Revenue/growth targets from partners (shown as the target of the first KPI row)

partner_support_capacity.description: How much partner support can you provide?

your_deal_size.description: Average deal size as one amount (e.g., '$5000 ACV', '$5K' or '$500/month'; a range is refused). It scales the example commission amounts; the example rates are fixed

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear.
